title: Natural and man-made materials
misconception: 1C-M2: thinks man-made materials do not come from nature at all
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: At the market you see many man-made materials.
Glass is made by heating sand until it melts.
Plastic is made from crude oil, which comes from the ground.
Many football jerseys are made of polyester, a material made from oil.
So man-made materials also start in nature.
The difference is that people change them into a new material.
A natural material is used much as it is found, like wood, cotton or leather.
Now it is your turn. Decide if a material is natural or man-made.
